title: The prime spectrum of rings of integer-coefficient power series on the disk
summary: This is a sequel to \cite{PaperI}, where it is shown that a discrete effective divisor on the open unit disk $\D$ is the zero divisor of a holomorphic function with integer Taylor coefficients if and only if it is invariant under complex conjugation. Building on that realization theorem and on the unit characterization established there, we study the prime and maximal spectra of the rings $R = \mathbb{Z}[i][[z]] \cap O(\mathbb{D})$ and $R_{\mathbb{R}} = \mathbb{Z}[[z]] \cap O(\mathbb{D})$.
